+name: Roster currency
+
+# Weekly check that every model the roster binds is still served
+# (specs/roster-currency-check). Advisory: never part of the per-PR gate
+# (ADR 0005); findings go to one tracking issue labelled roster-currency.
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: "17 13 * * 1"  # Mondays, 13:17 UTC
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  issues: write
+  id-token: write  # only to request the OIDC token for Anthropic federation
+
+jobs:
+  check:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.13"
+      - run: uv sync --frozen
+
+      # Anthropic via Workload Identity Federation when the rule is configured
+      # (R-12): no stored Anthropic secret, and no API key alongside it, since
+      # an API key outranks federation in the SDK.
+      - name: Fetch GitHub OIDC token for Anthropic
+        if: vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID != ''
+        run: |
+          curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" \
+            "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL&audience=https://api.anthropic.com" \
+            | jq -r .value > "$RUNNER_TEMP/gha-jwt"
+      - name: Check (federation)
+        if: vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID != ''
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
+          ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID: ${{ vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID }}
+          ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID: ${{ vars.ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID }}
+          ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
+          ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE: ${{ runner.temp }}/gha-jwt
+        run: uv run python -m agent_framework.currency --sync-issue
+
+      # Fallback: an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret, only when federation is not set up.
+      - name: Check (API key fallback)
+        if: vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID == ''
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
+          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
+        run: uv run python -m agent_framework.currency --sync-issue

+"""The roster currency check's entry point (scheduled CI, or by hand).
+
+    python -m agent_framework.currency [--roster PATH] [--sync-issue]
+
+Prints one line per finding; exits 1 when any finding is failing or
+unchecked, else 0. `--sync-issue` also opens, updates or closes the
+tracking issue. Credentials come only from the environment (R-8).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import asyncio
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from ..providers.anthropic import AnthropicProvider
+from ..providers.google import GoogleProvider
+from ..providers.registry import ProviderRegistry
+from ..roster import Roster
+from .check import check_roster
+from .issue import GhIssueTracker, needs_attention, render, sync_issue
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Check the roster's models are still served")
+    ap.add_argument("--roster", type=Path, default=Path("agent-framework.toml"))
+    ap.add_argument("--sync-issue", action="store_true",
+                    help="open/update/close the roster-currency tracking issue")
+    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
+
+    # An unset Actions secret arrives as "", which would still win the SDK's
+    # credential precedence over federation; treat empty as absent.
+    for name in ("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "GEMINI_API_KEY"):
+        if os.environ.get(name) == "":
+            del os.environ[name]
+
+    registry = ProviderRegistry()
+    registry.register("anthropic", AnthropicProvider())
+    registry.register("google", GoogleProvider())
+    findings = asyncio.run(check_roster(Roster.from_file(args.roster), registry))
+
+    print(render(findings))
+    if args.sync_issue:
+        print(sync_issue(findings, GhIssueTracker(), _run_url()))
+    return 1 if needs_attention(findings) else 0
+
+
+def _run_url() -> str | None:
+    server, repo, run = (os.environ.get(k) for k in
+                         ("GITHUB_SERVER_URL", "GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "GITHUB_RUN_ID"))
+    return f"{server}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}" if server and repo and run else None
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""The roster currency check's core: roster + provider catalogs → findings.
+
+Pure over its inputs (the roster and a provider registry), so every success
+criterion is a unit test over fake adapters. A model the provider no longer
+serves, or one it silently routes elsewhere, is *failing*; a provider that
+cannot be asked is *unchecked* — never passing (R-4); a newer model in the
+same family is *advisory* (R-9).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import StrEnum
+
+from ..errors import UnknownProviderError
+from ..providers.base import ModelCatalog, ModelProbe
+from ..providers.registry import ProviderRegistry
+from ..roster import Roster
+
+
+class Severity(StrEnum):
+    FAILING = "failing"
+    UNCHECKED = "unchecked"
+    ADVISORY = "advisory"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Finding:
+    severity: Severity
+    role: str
+    provider: str
+    model: str
+    message: str
+
+
+_VERSION_TOKEN = re.compile(r"^\d+(?:\.\d+)*$")
+_SNAPSHOT_TOKEN = re.compile(r"^\d{6,}$")  # date-stamped snapshots, e.g. 20250805
+
+
+def family_and_version(model_id: str) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]] | None:
+    """Split an ID into its family and version: `claude-sonnet-5-5` →
+    (`claude-sonnet-*`, (5, 5)); `gemini-3.8-flash` → (`gemini-*-flash`, (3, 8)).
+    None for IDs without a version or with a date snapshot (never a candidate)."""
+    shape: list[str] = []
+    version: list[int] = []
+    for token in model_id.split("-"):
+        if _SNAPSHOT_TOKEN.match(token):
+            return None
+        if _VERSION_TOKEN.match(token):
+            version.extend(int(n) for n in token.split("."))
+            if not shape or shape[-1] != "*":
+                shape.append("*")
+        else:
+            shape.append(token)
+    return ("-".join(shape), tuple(version)) if version else None
+
+
+def newest_sibling(model: str, served: tuple[str, ...]) -> str | None:
+    """The highest-versioned served model in `model`'s family, if newer than it."""
+    bound = family_and_version(model)
+    if bound is None:
+        return None
+    best: tuple[tuple[int, ...], str] | None = None
+    for candidate in served:
+        parsed = family_and_version(candidate)
+        if parsed and parsed[0] == bound[0] and parsed[1] > bound[1]:
+            if best is None or parsed[1] > best[0]:
+                best = (parsed[1], candidate)
+    return best[1] if best else None
+
+
+async def check_roster(roster: Roster, registry: ProviderRegistry) -> list[Finding]:
+    """Check every role's bound model against its provider's catalog."""
+    findings: list[Finding] = []
+    catalogs: dict[str, tuple[str, ...] | str] = {}  # served IDs, or why unchecked
+    for role, ref in sorted(roster.roles().items()):
+        if ref.provider not in catalogs:
+            catalogs[ref.provider] = await _catalog(ref.provider, registry)
+        catalog = catalogs[ref.provider]
+        for severity, message in await _check_binding(ref.provider, ref.model, catalog, registry):
+            findings.append(Finding(severity, role, ref.provider, ref.model, message))
+    return findings
+
+
+async def _check_binding(
+    provider: str, model: str, catalog: tuple[str, ...] | str, registry: ProviderRegistry
+) -> list[tuple[Severity, str]]:
+    if isinstance(catalog, str):
+        return [(Severity.UNCHECKED, catalog)]
+    if model not in catalog:
+        return [(Severity.FAILING, f"{provider} does not serve {model!r}")]
+    results: list[tuple[Severity, str]] = []
+    adapter = registry.get(provider)
+    if isinstance(adapter, ModelProbe):
+        try:
+            serving = await adapter.probe_model(model)
+        except Exception as e:  # a probe is best-effort (R-10, a SHOULD)
+            results.append((Severity.ADVISORY, f"routing probe failed: {e}"))
+        else:
+            if serving and not serving.startswith(model):
+                results.append((Severity.FAILING, f"{model!r} is served by {serving!r}"))
+    newer = newest_sibling(model, catalog)
+    if newer:
+        results.append((Severity.ADVISORY, f"newer model in the same family: {newer!r}"))
+    return results
+
+
+async def _catalog(provider: str, registry: ProviderRegistry) -> tuple[str, ...] | str:
+    try:
+        adapter = registry.get(provider)
+    except UnknownProviderError as e:
+        return str(e)
+    if not isinstance(adapter, ModelCatalog):
+        return f"the {provider} adapter cannot list models"
+    try:
+        return await adapter.list_models()
+    except Exception as e:  # missing credentials, outage: unchecked, never passing
+        return f"could not list {provider} models: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"

+"""The roster currency check's one tracking issue (R-5, R-11).
+
+`sync_issue` decides; an `IssueTracker` acts. The `gh`-backed tracker shells
+out through the shared subprocess seam; tests pass a fake.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Protocol
+
+from ..proc import Runner, run_command
+from .check import Finding, Severity
+
+LABEL = "roster-currency"
+TITLE = "Roster currency check: a bound model needs attention"
+
+
+class IssueTracker(Protocol):
+    def find_open(self, label: str) -> int | None: ...
+    def create(self, title: str, body: str, label: str) -> int: ...
+    def update(self, number: int, body: str) -> None: ...
+    def close(self, number: int, comment: str) -> None: ...
+
+
+def needs_attention(findings: list[Finding]) -> bool:
+    """Failing or unchecked findings keep the issue open; advisories alone do not."""
+    return any(f.severity is not Severity.ADVISORY for f in findings)
+
+
+def render(findings: list[Finding], run_url: str | None = None) -> str:
+    lines = [f"- **{f.severity}** — `{f.role}` ({f.provider}, `{f.model}`): {f.message}"
+             for f in findings] or ["- every bound model is served; nothing to report"]
+    if run_url:
+        lines.append(f"\nLatest run: {run_url}")
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def sync_issue(findings: list[Finding], tracker: IssueTracker, run_url: str | None = None) -> str:
+    """Open, update, or close the tracking issue; returns what it did."""
+    existing = tracker.find_open(LABEL)
+    body = render(findings, run_url)
+    if needs_attention(findings):
+        if existing is None:
+            return f"opened #{tracker.create(TITLE, body, LABEL)}"
+        tracker.update(existing, body)
+        return f"updated #{existing}"
+    if existing is not None:
+        tracker.close(existing, f"Resolved: no failing or unchecked findings.\n\n{body}")
+        return f"closed #{existing}"
+    return "no issue needed"
+
+
+class GhIssueTracker:
+    """An `IssueTracker` over the `gh` CLI (GH_TOKEN from the environment)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, run: Runner = run_command) -> None:
+        self._run = run
+
+    def find_open(self, label: str) -> int | None:
+        out = self._run(["gh", "issue", "list", "--label", label, "--state", "open",
+                         "--json", "number", "--jq", ".[0].number // empty"]).strip()
+        return int(out) if out else None
+
+    def create(self, title: str, body: str, label: str) -> int:
+        self._run(["gh", "label", "create", label, "--force",
+                   "--description", "Roster currency check findings"])
+        url = self._run(["gh", "issue", "create", "--title", title, "--body", body,
+                         "--label", label]).strip()
+        return int(url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
+
+    def update(self, number: int, body: str) -> None:
+        self._run(["gh", "issue", "edit", str(number), "--body", body])
+
+    def close(self, number: int, comment: str) -> None:
+        self._run(["gh", "issue", "close", str(number), "--comment", comment])

+from google import genai

+from agent_framework.providers.anthropic import AnthropicProvider
+from agent_framework.providers.base import ModelCatalog, ModelProbe

+def _anthropic(handler: Any) -> AnthropicProvider:

+    ))
+
+
+def _google(handler: Any) -> GoogleProvider:

+        http_options=types.HttpOptions(
+            async_client_args={"transport": httpx.MockTransport(handler)}
+        ),
+    ))

+    """SC-6: AnthropicProvider is a ModelCatalog (no probe) over GET /v1/models."""

+    provider = _anthropic(handler)
+    assert isinstance(provider, ModelCatalog) and not isinstance(provider, ModelProbe)

+"""Roster currency check core and CLI exit code.
+
+Verifies spec success criteria (specs/roster-currency-check):
+- SC-1: an unserved model is a failing finding; the run exits non-zero.
+- SC-2: an all-served roster has no failing finding; the run exits zero.
+- SC-3: an unlistable provider leaves its roles unchecked, never passing.
+- SC-6: providers are resolved through the registry, so a new adapter needs no check change.
+- SC-7: a newer model in the same family is advisory and does not fail the run.
+- SC-8: a probe reporting a different serving model is a failing finding naming both.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from agent_framework.currency import __main__ as cli
+from agent_framework.currency.check import (
+    Finding,
+    Severity,
+    check_roster,
+    family_and_version,
+    newest_sibling,
+)
+from agent_framework.providers.base import Provider
+from agent_framework.providers.registry import ProviderRegistry
+from agent_framework.roster import Roster
+
+from .fakes import BrokenCatalog, FakeCatalog, FakeProbingCatalog, NoCatalog
+
+
+def _roster(**roles: tuple[str, str]) -> Roster:
+    return Roster.from_dict(
+        {"roles": {r: {"provider": p, "model": m} for r, (p, m) in roles.items()}}
+    )
+
+
+def _registry(**providers: Provider) -> ProviderRegistry:
+    registry = ProviderRegistry()
+    for name, adapter in providers.items():
+        registry.register(name, adapter)
+    return registry
+
+
+async def test_sc1_unserved_model_is_a_failing_finding() -> None:
+    """SC-1: role, provider and model are named in the failing finding."""
+    findings = await check_roster(
+        _roster(validator=("google", "gemini-3-pro")),
+        _registry(google=FakeCatalog(("gemini-3.8-flash",))),
+    )
+    assert findings == [
+        Finding(Severity.FAILING, "validator", "google", "gemini-3-pro",
+                "google does not serve 'gemini-3-pro'")
+    ]
+
+
+async def test_sc2_all_served_roster_has_no_failing_finding() -> None:
+    """SC-2: every bound model listed → no failing or unchecked findings."""
+    findings = await check_roster(
+        _roster(worker=("anthropic", "claude-sonnet-5-5"), validator=("google", "gemini-3.8-flash")),
+        _registry(anthropic=FakeCatalog(("claude-sonnet-5-5",)),
+                  google=FakeProbingCatalog(("gemini-3.8-flash",))),
+    )
+    assert findings == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("adapter", [BrokenCatalog(), NoCatalog()])
+async def test_sc3_unlistable_provider_leaves_roles_unchecked(adapter: Provider) -> None:
+    """SC-3: a listing error or a catalog-less adapter → unchecked for each of its roles."""
+    findings = await check_roster(
+        _roster(chief=("anthropic", "claude-fable-5-1"), worker=("anthropic", "claude-sonnet-5-5")),
+        _registry(anthropic=adapter),
+    )
+    assert [(f.role, f.severity) for f in findings] == [
+        ("chief", Severity.UNCHECKED), ("worker", Severity.UNCHECKED)
+    ]
+
+
+async def test_sc3_unregistered_provider_is_unchecked() -> None:
+    """SC-3: a provider with no adapter at all is unchecked, not an error or a pass."""
+    findings = await check_roster(_roster(worker=("local", "qwen3-coder")), _registry())
+    assert [f.severity for f in findings] == [Severity.UNCHECKED]
+
+
+async def test_sc6_new_provider_needs_only_a_registered_adapter() -> None:
+    """SC-6: an adapter under a new provider name is checked through the registry."""
+    findings = await check_roster(
+        _roster(worker=("mlx", "qwen3-coder-next-4bit")),
+        _registry(mlx=FakeCatalog(("qwen3-coder-next-4bit",))),
+    )
+    assert findings == []
+
+
+async def test_sc7_newer_sibling_is_advisory_only() -> None:
+    """SC-7: the candidate is named, and the run still passes."""
+    findings = await check_roster(
+        _roster(worker=("anthropic", "claude-sonnet-5")),
+        _registry(anthropic=FakeCatalog(("claude-sonnet-5", "claude-sonnet-5-5", "claude-opus-5-5"))),
+    )
+    assert [(f.severity, f.message) for f in findings] == [
+        (Severity.ADVISORY, "newer model in the same family: 'claude-sonnet-5-5'")
+    ]
+
+
+def test_sc7_family_parsing_ignores_snapshots_and_other_tiers() -> None:
+    """SC-7: families group by shape; date snapshots and other tiers are never candidates."""
+    assert family_and_version("gemini-3.8-flash") == ("gemini-*-flash", (3, 8))
+    assert family_and_version("claude-sonnet-5-5") == ("claude-sonnet-*", (5, 5))
+    assert family_and_version("claude-opus-4-1-20250805") is None
+    served = ("gemini-3.8-flash", "gemini-3.9-flash-lite", "gemini-4-argon")
+    assert newest_sibling("gemini-3.6-flash", served) == "gemini-3.8-flash"
+    assert newest_sibling("gemini-3.8-flash", served) is None
+
+
+async def test_sc8_rerouted_model_is_a_failing_finding() -> None:
+    """SC-8: bound and serving model are both named."""
+    findings = await check_roster(
+        _roster(validator=("google", "gemini-3.5-flash")),
+        _registry(google=FakeProbingCatalog(
+            ("gemini-3.5-flash",), serving={"gemini-3.5-flash": "gemini-3.6-flash"}
+        )),
+    )
+    assert [(f.severity, f.message) for f in findings] == [
+        (Severity.FAILING, "'gemini-3.5-flash' is served by 'gemini-3.6-flash'")
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("severity", "exit_code"),
+    [(Severity.FAILING, 1), (Severity.UNCHECKED, 1), (Severity.ADVISORY, 0)],
+)
+def test_sc1_sc2_cli_exit_code_follows_findings(
+    severity: Severity, exit_code: int, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    """SC-1 / SC-2: non-zero only for failing or unchecked findings."""
+    roster = tmp_path / "agent-framework.toml"
+    roster.write_text('[roles]\nworker = { provider = "anthropic", model = "m-1" }\n')
+
+    async def fake_check(r: Roster, reg: ProviderRegistry) -> list[Finding]:
+        return [Finding(severity, "worker", "anthropic", "m-1", "x")]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cli, "check_roster", fake_check)
+    assert cli.main(["--roster", str(roster)]) == exit_code

+

+        self.open_issue = open_issue
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, int | None]] = []
+

+        assert label == LABEL
+        return self.open_issue
+
+    def create(self, title: str, body: str, label: str) -> int:
+        self.calls.append(("create", None))
+        return 7
+
+    def update(self, number: int, body: str) -> None:
+        self.calls.append(("update", number))
+
+    def close(self, number: int, comment: str) -> None:
+        self.calls.append(("close", number))

+    """SC-4: an open issue is updated; no second issue is created."""

+
+
+def test_r11_clean_run_closes_the_issue_and_advisories_alone_do_not_open_one() -> None:

+"""The roster currency workflow file.
+
+Verifies spec success criteria (specs/roster-currency-check):
+- SC-5: schedule + manual dispatch only; contents:read, issues:write and
+  id-token:write only; credentials only from secrets.*/vars.*; not in ci.yml.
+- SC-9: the federation step gets the federation variables and no API key;
+  the fallback step gets the API key only when federation is not configured;
+  the OIDC token is requested for audience https://api.anthropic.com.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import yaml
+
+_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+_WORKFLOW = _ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "roster-currency.yml"
+_FEDERATION_VARS = {
+    "ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID",
+    "ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID",
+    "ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID",
+    "ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE",
+}
+
+
+def _workflow() -> dict[Any, Any]:
+    data = yaml.safe_load(_WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    assert isinstance(data, dict)
+    return data
+
+
+def _steps() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    steps = _workflow()["jobs"]["check"]["steps"]
+    return {s["name"]: s for s in steps if "name" in s}
+
+
+def test_sc5_triggers_permissions_and_isolation_from_the_gate() -> None:
+    """SC-5: triggers, least-privilege token, and no reference from ci.yml."""
+    wf = _workflow()
+    triggers = wf[True]  # YAML 1.1 reads the bare key `on` as boolean True
+    assert set(triggers) == {"schedule", "workflow_dispatch"}
+    assert wf["permissions"] == {"contents": "read", "issues": "write", "id-token": "write"}
+    ci = (_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "roster-currency" not in ci and "agent_framework.currency" not in ci
+
+
+def test_sc5_credentials_come_only_from_secrets_and_vars() -> None:
+    """SC-5: every credential-looking env value is a secrets.* or vars.* expression."""
+    for step in _steps().values():
+        for name, value in (step.get("env") or {}).items():
+            if re.search(r"KEY|TOKEN|_ID$", name) and name != "ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE":
+                assert re.fullmatch(r"\$\{\{ (secrets|vars)\.\w+ \}\}", value), (name, value)
+
+
+def test_sc9_federation_and_api_key_are_never_combined() -> None:
+    """SC-9: federation step has the four variables and no key; fallback has the key."""
+    steps = _steps()
+    federation, fallback = steps["Check (federation)"], steps["Check (API key fallback)"]
+    assert federation["if"] == "vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID != ''"
+    assert _FEDERATION_VARS <= set(federation["env"])
+    assert "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" not in federation["env"]
+    assert fallback["if"] == "vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID == ''"
+    assert "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" in fallback["env"]
+    assert not _FEDERATION_VARS & set(fallback["env"])
+
+
+def test_sc9_oidc_token_requested_for_the_anthropic_audience() -> None:
+    """SC-9: the identity token is fetched only for federation, with Anthropic's audience."""
+    fetch = _steps()["Fetch GitHub OIDC token for Anthropic"]

tests.tests/currency/test_check.py:
"""Roster currency check core and CLI exit code.

Verifies spec success criteria (specs/roster-currency-check):
- SC-1: an unserved model is a failing finding; the run exits non-zero.
- SC-2: an all-served roster has no failing finding; the run exits zero.
- SC-3: an unlistable provider leaves its roles unchecked, never passing.
- SC-6: providers are resolved through the registry, so a new adapter needs no check change.
- SC-7: a newer model in the same family is advisory and does not fail the run.
- SC-8: a probe reporting a different serving model is a failing finding naming both.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from agent_framework.currency import __main__ as cli
from agent_framework.currency.check import (
    Finding,
    Severity,
    check_roster,
    family_and_version,
    newest_sibling,
)
from agent_framework.providers.base import Provider
from agent_framework.providers.registry import ProviderRegistry
from agent_framework.roster import Roster

from .fakes import BrokenCatalog, FakeCatalog, FakeProbingCatalog, NoCatalog


def _roster(**roles: tuple[str, str]) -> Roster:
    return Roster.from_dict(
        {"roles": {r: {"provider": p, "model": m} for r, (p, m) in roles.items()}}
    )


def _registry(**providers: Provider) -> ProviderRegistry:
    registry = ProviderRegistry()
    for name, adapter in providers.items():
        registry.register(name, adapter)
    return registry


async def test_sc1_unserved_model_is_a_failing_finding() -> None:
    """SC-1: role, provider and model are named in the failing finding."""
    findings = await check_roster(
        _roster(validator=("google", "gemini-3-pro")),
        _registry(google=FakeCatalog(("gemini-3.8-flash",))),
    )
    assert findings == [
        Finding(Severity.FAILING, "validator", "google", "gemini-3-pro",
                "google does not serve 'gemini-3-pro'")
    ]


async def test_sc2_all_served_roster_has_no_failing_finding() -> None:
    """SC-2: every bound model listed → no failing or unchecked findings."""
    findings = await check_roster(
        _roster(worker=("anthropic", "claude-sonnet-5-5"), validator=("google", "gemini-3.8-flash")),
        _registry(anthropic=FakeCatalog(("claude-sonnet-5-5",)),
                  google=FakeProbingCatalog(("gemini-3.8-flash",))),
    )
    assert findings == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("adapter", [BrokenCatalog(), NoCatalog()])
async def test_sc3_unlistable_provider_leaves_roles_unchecked(adapter: Provider) -> None:
    """SC-3: a listing error or a catalog-less adapter → unchecked for each of its roles."""
    findings = await check_roster(

tests.tests/currency/test_issue.py:
"""The roster currency check's tracking issue.

Verifies spec success criteria (specs/roster-currency-check):
- SC-4: a failing run updates an open tracking issue rather than opening a
  duplicate, and opens exactly one when none is open.
Also covers R-11 (a SHOULD): a clean run closes the open issue.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from agent_framework.currency.check import Finding, Severity
from agent_framework.currency.issue import LABEL, GhIssueTracker, sync_issue

_FAILING = [Finding(Severity.FAILING, "validator", "google", "gemini-3-pro", "not served")]
_ADVISORY = [Finding(Severity.ADVISORY, "worker", "anthropic", "claude-sonnet-5", "newer")]


class FakeTracker:
    def __init__(self, open_issue: int | None = None) -> None:
        self.open_issue = open_issue
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, int | None]] = []

    def find_open(self, label: str) -> int | None:
        assert label == LABEL
        return self.open_issue

    def create(self, title: str, body: str, label: str) -> int:
        self.calls.append(("create", None))
        return 7

    def update(self, number: int, body: str) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("update", number))

    def close(self, number: int, comment: str) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("close", number))


def test_sc4_failing_run_updates_the_open_issue() -> None:
    """SC-4: an open issue is updated; no second issue is created."""
    tracker = FakeTracker(open_issue=3)
    assert sync_issue(_FAILING, tracker) == "updated #3"
    assert tracker.calls == [("update", 3)]


def test_sc4_failing_run_opens_exactly_one_issue() -> None:
    """SC-4: with no open issue, exactly one is created."""
    tracker = FakeTracker()
    assert sync_issue(_FAILING, tracker) == "opened #7"
    assert tracker.calls == [("create", None)]


def test_r11_clean_run_closes_the_issue_and_advisories_alone_do_not_open_one() -> None:
    """R-11: nothing failing or unchecked → the open issue is closed; none is opened."""
    tracker = FakeTracker(open_issue=3)
    assert sync_issue(_ADVISORY, tracker) == "closed #3"
    assert tracker.calls == [("close", 3)]
    assert sync_issue(_ADVISORY, FakeTracker()) == "no issue needed"


def test_sc4_gh_tracker_finds_and_creates_through_the_gh_cli() -> None:
    """SC-4: the gh-backed tracker reads the open issue number and the created issue's URL."""
    commands: list[list[str]] = []

    def run(args: object) -> str:
        cmd = list(args)  # type: ignore[call-overload]
        commands.append(cmd)
        if cmd[:3] == ["gh", "issue", "list"]:
            return "\n"
        if cmd[:3] == ["gh", "issue", "create"]:
            return "https://github.com/vpciii/agent-framework/issues/12\n"
        return ""

    tracker = GhIssueTracker(run=run)
    assert tracker.find_open(LABEL) is None
    assert tracker.create("t", "b", LABEL) == 12
    assert ["gh", "label", "create", LABEL] == commands[1][:4]
tests.tests/currency/test_workflow.py:
"""The roster currency workflow file.

Verifies spec success criteria (specs/roster-currency-check):
- SC-5: schedule + manual dispatch only; contents:read, issues:write and
  id-token:write only; credentials only from secrets.*/vars.*; not in ci.yml.
- SC-9: the federation step gets the federation variables and no API key;
  the fallback step gets the API key only when federation is not configured;
  the OIDC token is requested for audience https://api.anthropic.com.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml

_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
_WORKFLOW = _ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "roster-currency.yml"
_FEDERATION_VARS = {
    "ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID",
    "ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID",
    "ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID",
    "ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE",
}


def _workflow() -> dict[Any, Any]:
    data = yaml.safe_load(_WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    return data


def _steps() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    steps = _workflow()["jobs"]["check"]["steps"]
    return {s["name"]: s for s in steps if "name" in s}


def test_sc5_triggers_permissions_and_isolation_from_the_gate() -> None:
    """SC-5: triggers, least-privilege token, and no reference from ci.yml."""
    wf = _workflow()
    triggers = wf[True]  # YAML 1.1 reads the bare key `on` as boolean True
    assert set(triggers) == {"schedule", "workflow_dispatch"}
    assert wf["permissions"] == {"contents": "read", "issues": "write", "id-token": "write"}
    ci = (_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "roster-currency" not in ci and "agent_framework.currency" not in ci


def test_sc5_credentials_come_only_from_secrets_and_vars() -> None:
    """SC-5: every credential-looking env value is a secrets.* or vars.* expression."""
    for step in _steps().values():
        for name, value in (step.get("env") or {}).items():
            if re.search(r"KEY|TOKEN|_ID$", name) and name != "ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE":
                assert re.fullmatch(r"\$\{\{ (secrets|vars)\.\w+ \}\}", value), (name, value)


def test_sc9_federation_and_api_key_are_never_combined() -> None:
    """SC-9: federation step has the four variables and no key; fallback has the key."""
    steps = _steps()
    federation, fallback = steps["Check (federation)"], steps["Check (API key fallback)"]
    assert federation["if"] == "vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID != ''"
    assert _FEDERATION_VARS <= set(federation["env"])
    assert "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" not in federation["env"]
    assert fallback["if"] == "vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID == ''"
    assert "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" in fallback["env"]
    assert not _FEDERATION_VARS & set(fallback["env"])


def test_sc9_oidc_token_requested_for_the_anthropic_audience() -> None:
    """SC-9: the identity token is fetched only for federation, with Anthropic's audience."""
    fetch = _steps()["Fetch GitHub OIDC token for Anthropic"]
    assert fetch["if"] == "vars.ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID != ''"
    assert "audience=https://api.anthropic.com" in fetch["run"]

  registering a fake adapter under a new provider name makes roles bound
